title: Immediate flip failure could advance the sequence twice
description:
For steps not waiting on the imager, flip_failed called failure() at once; an advance timer not stored in wait_for_timer (0 s step completion, pause polling, altitude completion) or a step waiting on the device whose Alert failed the flip could cause a second execute_next. Next: defer the failure to the end of the step unless a cancellable step timer runs.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261103010401-8b51-flip-failure-recovery-002.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
